Entry_Condition: Persisted raw observation fails mandatory technical validity OR separately governed evidence establishes a source-field defect.
Exit_Condition: Authoritative same-identity/date/basis correction replaces evidence under a separately authorized correction gate, or defect is formally disproven.
Downstream_Behavior: Raw row remains immutable; attach defect metadata; determine technical-use eligibility separately.
Audit_Provenance: Security_Key, Source_WS_ID, provider symbol/source, observation date, failed relation/evidence class, source artifact/hash.
Fail_Closed_Behavior: Defect itself never becomes a fabricated valid bar.

Entry_Condition: Evidence distinguishes CLOSE_UNTRUSTED, RANGE_FIELD_UNTRUSTED, VOLUME_UNTRUSTED, FULL_BAR_UNTRUSTED, or corroborated field.
Downstream_Behavior: Evidence metadata only in selected v0.52 policy; current technical pipeline does not selectively consume a field from an otherwise invalid bar.
Audit_Provenance: Evidence source and authority class per field.
Fail_Closed_Behavior: Unverified field trust never upgrades technical use.

Entry_Condition: SOURCE_DATA_DEFECT row fails current technical_valid_mask or future governed source-defect overlay marks the bar unusable.
Exit_Condition: Bar receives authoritative valid correction under separate gate.
Downstream_Behavior: Exclude whole bar from technical feature series; never rewrite/impute/delete raw row.
Audit_Provenance: Excluded date count and reason retained; feature output retains Excluded_Invalid_Bars.
Fail_Closed_Behavior: No technical feature may read the excluded raw values.

Entry_Condition: All promoted v0.4 conditions hold: <=2 invalid bars, <=1% raw share, >=260 valid bars, sufficient history/currentness, no unresolved suspicious-return blocker.
Exit_Condition: Any criterion ceases to hold or new material contradiction emerges.
Downstream_Behavior: Eligible for later cache-state READY classification with ISOLATED_INVALID_BAR_EXCLUDED/FILTERED_INVALID_BARS_EXCLUDED after implementation validation; not promoted in v0.52.
Audit_Provenance: Raw/valid counts, invalid share, reason, last valid date, suspicious-return count.
Fail_Closed_Behavior: Any failed criterion leaves security non-ready.

Entry_Condition: >2 invalid bars OR >1% invalid share OR insufficient valid/history/currentness OR suspicious-return/other higher-priority blocker.
Exit_Condition: Condition is remediated and full generic gate passes.
